exampleEn: It took her a while to get over the disappointment.
exampleKo: 그 실망을 극복하는 데 그녀는 한동안 걸렸다.
gameExamples: After a tough breakup, he struggled to get over his ex-girlfriend.
She didn’t know how long it would take to get over her fear of public speaking.
It’s important to give yourself time to get over any setbacks in life.
